planned_figures.1_recall: X: condition C0–C6; Y: phishing recall (0–1); one line per frozen detector.
planned_figures.2_probability_change: X: C1–C6; Y: P(C0)−P(Ci) on phishing frames; detector-specific means and paired frame bootstrap 95% intervals.
planned_figures.3_distance_change: X: prespecified surface distance; Y: P(C0)−P(Ci); each point a phishing variant, color identifies detector.
planned_figures.4_transitions: X: condition; Y: four directional decision transitions; cells show counts separately per detector.
planned_figures.5_trajectory: X: C0–C6; Y: phishing probability (0–1); two detector lines and fixed 0.5 threshold. Frame nearest median mean absolute paired shift, ties by stable ID.
